data.title: 白井黑子 · 三明治要摆整齐
data.description: 休息日的小茶桌旁，黑子把三角三明治的尖角朝同一方向摆好。她满意地端详了一眼，才把茶杯放到你这边。
data.promptProse: At a cafe window table, Kuroko wears a navy gingham pinafore over a white puff-sleeved blouse. She aligns small triangular sandwiches on a plate, with a teacup set at the viewer side of the table. Soft daylight lights the tablecloth and her pleased expression.
data.animaCaption: Her fingertips adjust one sandwich on the plate; the teacup rests safely on its saucer.
data.action: 调整三角三明治在盘中的方向
